description: Describes the transport parameters of a Receiver of urn:x-padl:transport:dante, a native Dante receive channel, which is patched by subscribing it to a transmit channel. The constraints in this schema are minimum constraints, but may be further constrained at the constraints endpoint. Dante Receivers must support all parameters in this schema.
title: Dante Receiver Transport Parameters

device_name.description: Name of the Dante device whose transmit channel the receive channel subscribes to. A null value indicates that the receiver is not subscribed.

channel_name.description: Name of the transmit channel on that device. A null value indicates that the receiver is not subscribed.
